description:
Emma-Jean Thackray delivers a downtempo and absorbing number, flexing the jazz elements of the original into a smooth and encapsulating mix that's primed to lose yourself in!
 
The much revered and talked about London based, jazz and electronic composer/producer, who's track Movementt that dropped earlier this year set her up a notable one to watch. Repped by the likes of Gilles Peterson, RBMA, Sounds of The Universe and many more.
